# origincloud_network_acls (Data Source)

Lists the ACLs in a region, oldest first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose acls to list.
- `region` (String) The region whose acls to list.

### Read-Only

- `acls` (Attributes List) The acls listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acls))

<a id="nestedatt--acls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acls`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the ACL was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the ACL, by its full name on iam: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`, or a platform service agent's or service's name when the platform did.
- `id` (String) The acl's full resource name, `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/acls/{acl}`: what an argument that refers to the acl takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The ACL's resource name.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.
- `vpc` (String) The full name of the VPC the ACL belongs to, in the same project and region.
- `vpc_default` (Boolean) Whether the platform created the ACL with the VPC. Only the project's default VPC has such resources. It can't be deleted, and goes with its VPC.
